Session 18: 9->47 by guessing ATS slugs from company names and validating against the live API (34 new Greenhouse + 4 new Lever, ~14% hit rate, 3 slug collisions caught and rejected). Session 19: 47->58 by inverting the method — fetching each candidate's own real career page and reading its actual ATS directly off of it (1 new Greenhouse + 10 new Comeet, lower raw hit rate but zero collision risk). Session 20: 58->63 using the same domain-first method against a real, research-sourced candidate list (Calcalist/CTech 2026 funding-rounds coverage + StartupBlink's Israel ranking) rather than a hand-compiled name list — 3 new Greenhouse + 2 new Comeet; 2 raw hits (Enigma, CopilotKit) rejected on review for zero Israel signal, the exact generic-word-collision risk flagged going into that session. Session 32: 63->71 — a Growth playbook Phase 1 session aimed at recognizing Workday/SmartRecruiters/iCIMS (0 real hits for those 3) turned up 8 real hits on the 4 platforms this project already supports instead, re-checking Session 21's zero-signal batch with web research (real career-page URLs, since Session 21's own candidate list/script were never committed) and PlaywrightProbe: 6 new Comeet (2 via PlaywrightProbe directly, 4 via web research surfacing a real Comeet link the probe's evidence sources didn't cover), 2 new Greenhouse (Datarails, newly listed since Session 21; Aidoc, one of Session 21's 3 robots.txt-blocked companies — its WAF still blocks this project's httpx client but not Playwright's real browser). Session 35: 71->76 — custom-domain-focused harvesting (2 new real candidates: Port, Kela Technologies) plus resolving 3 of Session 32's 8 genuinely-unresolved companies (Coralogix, Guesty, Upwind) after finding they white-label/embed Comeet in a way the public comeet.com URL scheme never reveals — the real company-uid was recoverable from an individual job's apply-iframe URL even with no visible public link on the page (see discovery/playwright_probe.py's new CM_WIDGET_UID_RE, fixing the comeet.co detection gap Session 32 flagged). See ARCHITECTURE.md/PROGRESS.md Session 18-20/32/35 notes for the honest shortfall against the ~200 Greenhouse target and each session's sourcing method. 2 entries (Optimove/Mobileye) are EU-region-hosted, live-verified in Session 13. This is still NOT the ~8,000-9,000-company target universe. Harvesting the full list happens via Claude Code sessions per ADR-0023, not as part of routine scans.
